title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence

clauses.title: Proportionality and Do No Harm
clauses.text: The use of AI systems must not go beyond what is necessary to achieve a legitimate aim...

clauses.title: Safety and Security
clauses.text: Unwanted harms (safety risks) and vulnerabilities to attacks (security risks) should be avoided...

clauses.title: Fairness and Non-discrimination
clauses.text: AI actors should promote social justice and safeguard human rights...
